scientific_role: prediction-first mechanism probe for a multi-layer frozen RAD-DINO spatial decoder with train-normal-calibrated variable-area soft supervision; not a pseudo-mask consumer
scientific_question: Can intermediate and final RAD-DINO spatial tokens plus absolute normal-calibrated soft regions and bidirectional local affinity transfer improve variable tumor extent over the rejected fixed-top-1-percent affinity decoder?
hypothesis: Final-layer-only fixed-rank supervision preserves localization but imposes nearly fixed support. Fusing layers 4, 8 and 12, supervising variable-area absolute anomaly evidence, refining foreground and background symmetrically, and enforcing flip consistency will improve p90 shape without task-specific spatial labels.

implementation_amendment.scope: evaluator gate-schema compatibility and ambiguous-only positive-teacher handling
implementation_amendment.reason: the bootstrap helper returns ci95 as [low, high], while the v1 gate read a nonexistent ci95_low key; version 2 then showed one positive training image with no calibrated foreground or background region, which the protocol assigns only image-level SmoothMax supervision but the loss incorrectly rejected
implementation_amendment.v1_state_when_detected: kernel running; no v1 result accepted
implementation_amendment.v2_state_when_detected: teacher cache frozen with exactly one ambiguous-only positive; no checkpoint, prediction, validation GT evaluation or result accepted
implementation_amendment.ambiguous_only_behavior: omit only the unavailable pseudo-region term; retain image-level SmoothMax and do not inject a foreground rank

literature_transfer.paper: Ru et al., Token Contrast for Weakly-Supervised Semantic Segmentation, CVPR 2023
literature_transfer.transferred_mechanism: intermediate transformer tokens retain local discrimination that can be lost by final-layer token over-smoothing
literature_transfer.not_transferred: natural-image class-token pseudo masks, PASCAL/COCO hyperparameter selection and any pixel supervision

literature_transfer.paper: Wang et al., Self-Supervised Equivariant Attention Mechanism, CVPR 2020
literature_transfer.transferred_mechanism: aligned horizontal-view consistency under image-level supervision
literature_transfer.not_transferred: SEAM architecture, natural-image weights and validation-tuned settings

literature_transfer.paper: Zhang et al., Frozen CLIP: A Strong Backbone for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation, CVPR 2024
literature_transfer.transferred_mechanism: frozen multi-layer foundation-model features, lightweight trainable spatial decoder and dynamic affinity refinement
literature_transfer.not_transferred: CLIP text encoder, language prompts, static natural-image CAMs, DenseCRF and VOC/COCO settings

training_inputs_allowed: deterministic grayscale and finite-difference guidance from each radiograph
normal-memory anomaly evidence fitted only from the 1493 clean-training normal radiographs
training_inputs_forbidden: BTXRD polygons, masks, boxes, points, scribbles, lesion area or subgroup identity
validation or test images in the training cache, normal memory or calibration
validation GT metrics for epoch, threshold, hidden-layer, support, loss-weight or TTA selection
weak_supervision_contract.validation_image_labels: may accompany the frozen validation radiographs but are recorded only for image-level AUROC; decoder maps are not zeroed or routed by them
weak_supervision_contract.validation_gt: may be imported only by the separate evaluator after the checkpoint, all 371 maps, prediction manifest, prediction_freeze.json and run_manifest.json exist and are hash-verified

frozen_rad_dino.input: black square pad, bicubic 448x448 resize and frozen RAD-DINO normalization

frozen_projection.method: seed-42 Gaussian random projection followed by per-token L2 normalization
frozen_projection.purpose: reduce the three-layer training cache to approximately 2.35 GB while retaining local token geometry

normal_memory_teacher.global_retrieval: top 8 normal images by normalized final-layer CLS cosine; leave-one-image-out for normal calibration
normal_memory_teacher.patch_distance: one minus maximum projected-token cosine within plus/minus 2 patch positions among retrieved normal contexts
normal_memory_teacher.calibration: empirical CDF fitted on all leave-one-image-out train-normal patch distances only
normal_memory_teacher.positive_teacher: empirical normal-tail percentile for every final-layer projected patch

architecture.layer_inputs: three 32x32x128 projected token grids from RAD-DINO layers 4, 8 and 12
architecture.layer_fusion: independent trainable 1x1 projections, learned three-way softmax layer weights, concatenation and 1x1 fusion
architecture.spatial_body: three depthwise-separable residual blocks at 32x32 with hidden width 128
architecture.guidance: 64x64 grayscale, horizontal difference and vertical difference
architecture.prediction_head: guidance-aware residual fusion to one 64x64 logit map

local_affinity.learned: sigmoid of normalized decoder-feature cosine divided by temperature 0.20
local_affinity.frozen_filter: nonnegative normalized final-layer projected-token cosine raised to power 2
local_affinity.normalization: per-pixel 5x5 row normalization including the identity edge

bidirectional_refinement.foreground: seed-preserving local propagation of the continuous anomaly percentile
bidirectional_refinement.background: seed-preserving local propagation of one minus the anomaly percentile
bidirectional_refinement.output: foreground divided by foreground plus background

soft_region_supervision.reason: absolute empirical normal-tail evidence yields variable support; thresholds are round train-normal calibration anchors, not validation-fitted lesion fractions
soft_region_supervision.positive_without_foreground_weight: image-level SmoothMax remains active; no artificial foreground rank is injected
soft_region_supervision.normal: dense all-background BCE on valid radiograph content

loss.image_level: binary BCE over alpha-12 SmoothMax of the 64x64 sigmoid map
loss.soft_region: balanced weighted foreground/background BCE from the refined continuous teacher
loss.soft_affinity: balanced same/different confident-pair BCE over non-self 5x5 local pairs in positive images
loss.flip_consistency: masked MSE between original probability and aligned horizontal-flip probability

training.checkpoint_selection: final epoch only; no validation selection

prediction.square_prediction: mean of original sigmoid map and spatially aligned horizontal-flip sigmoid map
prediction.inverse_geometry: crop exact square-content box and bilinear resize to 320x320
prediction.normal_images: not forced to zero by validation image label
prediction.normalization: sigmoid probabilities only; no per-image min-max

baseline.arm: frozen RAD-DINO affinity-decoder v3 validation maps

continuous: image-level AUROC from raw foreground p99 over all 371 images
evaluation.comparison: candidate minus frozen affinity decoder for every localization metric with paired complete-group bootstrap
evaluation.complete_misses: reported for every fixed diagnostic and subgroup

relative_required.overall_dice_p90: candidate-minus-affinity paired complete-group CI95 lower bound >0
relative_required.subgroups_dice_p90: mean delta >=0 separately for small, medium and large

predeclared_gate.on_pass: authorize only a separately predeclared partial-soft-label consumer protocol; do not train automatically
predeclared_gate.on_fail: reject this exact configuration without changing hidden layers, thresholds, losses, weights, TTA or gate after validation GT

relation_to_operational_goal.interpretation: this prediction probe does not itself satisfy the final consumer goal; it tests whether a stronger variable-area spatial signal justifies a separately frozen consumer
